The screen displays a cladogram titled 'Ungulate Cladogram (Casual Names)' with two branches labeled 'Perissodactyls' and 'Artiodactyls', indicating odd-toed and even-toed ungulates respectively.

The screen displays a cladogram titled 'Ungulate Cladogram (Casual Names)' with two branches: 'Perissodactyls' and 'Artiodactyls', both under the main category 'Ungulates'. The text is static, and there are no visible hand actions or object interactions.
The term 'Horses' is added to the cladogram under Perissodactyls (odd-toed ungulates).

The video shows a cladogram of ungulates, starting with 'Ungulates' branching into 'Perissodactyls' (odd-toed ungulates) and 'Artiodactyls' (even-toed ungulates). The 'Perissodactyls' branch further into 'Horses'. The 'Artiodactyls' branch into 'Whippomorphs', which then splits into 'Ruminants' and 'Pecorans'. 'Ruminants' include 'Hippos' and 'Cetacea', while 'Pecorans' include 'Mouse Deer'.
The screen displays a detailed cladogram of ungulates, highlighting the classification of horses under perissodactyls and ruminants under artiodactyls.

The speaker gestures while explaining the Ungulate Cladogram (Casual Names), highlighting the classification of Ungulates into Perissodactyls and Artiodactyls, with further breakdowns into Horses, Whippomorphs, Hippos, Cetacea, Ruminants, Pecorans, and Mouse Deer.
